F10-Admin-Onboarding-Config-1280.dc.html.title: F10 · A4 & A7 Lab review & config · 1280

tA.text: A · Tokens and core components (provisional brand)

nA1.text:
API / code mapping
• Tokens ship as CSS variables in packages/ui (Tailwind theme reads them). Components use SEMANTIC tokens only.
• --qci-* brand primitives are PROVISIONAL stand-ins (OQ-19). When QCI sends official HEX values, change only those lines.
• Status tone groups map the BookingStatus enum (enums.yaml) → one source: packages/ui/status.ts.
• Deviation: --color-border-strong is gray-500 (not gray-400) so input borders reach 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

nA2.text:
API / code mapping
• Money = {amountPaise:int64, currency:'INR'} (common.yaml) → formatted en-IN: ₹1,00,000.00. Never float.
• DateTime: API timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 → displayed IST with the 'IST' suffix; dates DD MMM YYYY.
• BookingNo: bookingNo (LC-YYMM-NNNNNNN, OQ-22).
• FileUpload state ← BookingAttachment.scanStatus.
• Masked: phone/bank masked by the server (e.g. bankAccountNumberLast4); the client never unmasks.

nA3.text:
API / code mapping
• NextActionCard ← status + the matching deadline: labDecisionDueAt · paymentDueAt · dropDeadlineAt · holdCase.dueAt · counterOffer.expiresAt · disputeWindowEndsAt.
• BookingTimeline ← GET /bookings/{id}/timeline: kind (STATUS_CHANGE | CUSTODY_EVENT), occurredAt, actorRole, actorName (own org only, OQ-29), fromStatus, toStatus, custodyEventType, packageSeqNo.
• LabResultCard ← LabSearchResult.
• ApprovalPanel 'blocked' ← LabInboxItem.viewerWasMaker (the API refuses as well).
• CameraScanner ← POST /custody/scan → CustodyScanResult.result.

nA4.text:
API / code mapping
• VerificationResult ← ReportVerification.result: GENUINE_CURRENT | GENUINE_SUPERSEDED | NOT_FOUND | REVOKED.
• DataTable pagination ← page (cursor) on every *List schema.
• ErrorState copy comes from ERROR_HANDLING.md code → message map (e.g. 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION → 'This booking has moved on. Refresh to see its current state.').
• DiffViewer ← change-set items / price-list versions. ImportPreview ← import rows (create / update / no change / conflict / error).

tB.text: B · Public: search, lab site page, report verification

nB1.text:
API fields: GET /public/search/labs → LabSearchResultList
• Card: labSite.name, city, stateCode · labSite.accreditations[].certificateNo / status / statusAsOf · labSite.listingStatus (BOOKABLE | LISTED) · distanceKm · priceFrom · minTatDays · nextSlotAt · labSite.rating.average / count
• Why matched: matchedLines[] (scopeLine.parameter, method, price, tatDays), matchedLineCount → 'max 3 + N more'
• Map pins: labSite.location
• Filters: radiusKm (5|10|25|50|100), discipline, tatMax, priceMax, category
• Typeahead: GET /public/search/suggest → SearchSuggestion.kind / label

nB1m.text:
Same fields as B1 · 1280.
Below lg (1024): list/map toggle instead of split view. Filters move into a sheet. Card shows max 3 matched lines + 'N more'.

nB2.text:
API fields
• GET /public/lab-sites/{siteId} → PublicLabSite: name, siteCode, address, location, listingStatus, rating, receivingHours[] (weekday, opensAt, closesAt, cutoffAt)
• Accreditation card ← accreditations[]: certificateNo, accreditationBody, standard, validFrom, validTo, status, statusAsOf, verificationUrl
• Scope tree ← GET …/scope → PublicScopeLine: discipline › group › product › parameter, method, rangeText, temporarilyUnavailable
• Prices ← GET …/prices → PublicPriceItem: price, samplePrep, gstRateBp, sampleQty, sampleUnit, packagingInstructions, tatDays, isAvailable
• Next slots ← GET …/slots → PublicSlot (date, startsAt, endsAt)

nB3.text:
API fields: GET /public/verify/{verificationCode} → ReportVerification
• result → the big state
• report (VerifiedReport): reportNo, ulrNo, versionNo, issueDate, labSite, accreditation, approvedBy, supersededBy, stampedSha256
• 'Compare a copy' hashes the chosen PDF in the browser (SHA-256) and compares it with stampedSha256. The file is never uploaded.
• Showing approvedBy name + designation is OQ-15 (default: shown).
• Verification code is in the path, never personal data.

nB4.text:
API fields
• No results: data = [] → POST /public/leads (LeadCreate: kind, labSiteId, query, contactEmail)
• Listed: listingStatus = LISTED → 'Request this lab' (lead)
• Calibration: site is calibration-only → 'Calibration booking coming soon' (deferred feature, no booking UI)
• Loading: skeleton cards while the request is in flight

tC.text: C · Customer booking flow C3–C6 and booking detail C7

nC3.text:
API fields (BookingCreate)
• lines[].scopeLineId (pre-selected from search matchedLines)
• trf: BookingTrfInput {schemaVersion, form.* (item, grade, batch/lot, mfg date, condition, standard, special instructions), conformityRequired, decisionRule}
• Sample qty per line ← PublicPriceItem.sampleQty + sampleUnit
• declaredPackageCount (suggested from quantities)
• Draft autosaves on the client; validation = Zod schemas generated from the contract.

nC3r.text:
API fields
• POST /bookings/estimate → BookingEstimate: lines[] (snapshot.parameter, unitPrice, samplePrep, gst, lineTotal), subtotal, gst, total
• platformFee exists in the contract but is NEVER shown (platform fees are out of scope).
• POST /bookings/duplicate-check {itemName, batchNo, lines} → duplicateFound, windowDays, matches[]
• Submit: POST /bookings {labSiteId, customerSiteId, slotId, preferredDropDate, declaredPackageCount, lines, trf} → bookingNo, status REQUESTED, labDecisionDueAt

nC3m.text:
Same fields as C3 · 1280.
• Slot step: GET /public/lab-sites/{siteId}/slots → only valid PublicSlot rows are selectable.
• Duplicate modal ← BookingDuplicateCheck.matches[] (bookingNo, status, createdAt, labSiteName).
• Sticky bottom bar holds the one primary action per step.

nC4.text:
API fields
• counterOffer: status, proposedSlot, perLineQuantity[] (lineId, sampleQty, unitCode), message, expiresAt
• Accept: POST /bookings/{id}/counter/accept (T-07). Decline: POST /bookings/{id}/counter/decline (T-08).
• No price field anywhere in a counter-offer (BR-017).

nC45.text:
API fields
• Accepted: status ACCEPTED, total, paymentDueAt
• Rejected: rejection {reason, notes}; alternatives from GET /public/search/labs with the same lines
• Pay: POST /bookings/{id}/payments → PaymentCheckout {paymentOrder, gatewayCheckout}. Gateway page is opaque (FakePaymentGateway until ICICI docs land).
• Return: /payments/return then poll the booking until PAID → HANDOVER_SET.
• Receipt: GET /bookings/{id}/financial-documents

nC6.text:
API fields: GET /bookings/{id}/handover → BookingHandover
• labSite (name, address, location), receivingHours, submissionInstructions, labContact (masked phone)
• slot, preferredDropDate, dropDeadlineAt
• bookingQrPayload; packages[] (seqNo, totalPackages, shortCode, labelVersion, status, qrPayload)
• Labels: GET /bookings/{id}/labels.pdf (A4 sheet or thermal)

nC6m.text:
Same fields as C6 · 1280.
'At the lab' view: full-width booking QR, short code in large type, 'turn brightness up' hint. Works offline once loaded.

nC7.text:
API fields
• GET /bookings/{id} → BookingForCustomer: bookingNo, status, statusChangedAt, labSnapshot, lines[] (snapshot.parameter, status), expectedReportDate, total, deviationNoted
• Timeline ← GET /bookings/{id}/timeline: actorRole always; actorName only for your own organisation (OQ-29), so lab staff show as 'Lab Maker' / 'Lab Checker'.
• Custody trail PDF: GET /bookings/{id}/custody-trail.pdf

nC7h.text:
API fields
• holdCase: status, reason, details, dueAt (24 h), decision
• Photos: the receipt photos the lab attached
• POST /bookings/{id}/hold/decision {decision: PROCEED | REPLACE | CANCEL, reasonCode, notes}
  PROCEED → T-16 (deviation noted on the report) · REPLACE → Maker records a new receipt (T-17) · CANCEL → T-27 per-line refund

nC7m.text: Same fields as C7 · 1280 and C7 hold.

tD.text: D · Lab Maker counter scanner (L3) and Checker approvals (L4, L7)

nD2.text:
API fields
• GET /lab/inbox → LabInboxItem {booking, pendingApproval, viewerWasMaker}
• ReceiptRecord: makerUserId, submittedAt, packages[], photoFileIds, itemMatches, batchMatches, quantitySufficient, sealIntact, discrepancyFlag, discrepancyNotes
• Approve: POST /receipts/{id}/approve {labSampleId, notes} (T-14)
• Hold: POST /receipts/{id}/confirm-discrepancy {reason, details, labSampleId} (T-15)
• Unfit: POST /receipts/{id}/reject-unfit {reason} (T-28)
Tweak 'viewerIsMaker' shows the blocked state.

nD3.text:
API fields
• ReportVersion: versionNo, status IN_REVIEW, isAmendment, amendmentReason, issueDate, boundPackage, parameterResults[], makerUserId, stampedSha256
• Preview: GET /report-versions/{id}/download-url
• Publish: step-up via POST /auth/mfa/verify (≤ 5 min), then POST /report-versions/{id}/publish (T-21)
• Return: POST /report-versions/{id}/return {comments} (T-20)

tE.text: E · Dashboards: customer, Maker, Checker, Ops

nE1.text:
API fields
• GET /bookings → BookingSummary[]: bookingNo, status, itemName, labSite.name, total, labDecisionDueAt, paymentDueAt, dropDeadlineAt, expectedReportDate
• 'Needs your action' = COUNTERED, ACCEPTED, HANDOVER_SET, ON_HOLD (+ REPORT_RELEASED while disputeWindowEndsAt is in the future)
• Notifications: GET /me/notifications

nE2.text:
API fields
GET /lab/inbox, filtered: HANDOVER_SET with drop due today · UNDER_TEST with expectedReportDate · report versions RETURNED.
Scan now → D1 scanner.

nE3.text:
API fields
• GET /lab/inbox → pendingApproval (receipt | report | reprint) with SLA; REQUESTED with labDecisionDueAt
• GET /lab/onboarding → bookability gaps
• Disputes from /disputes for the lab org

nE4.text:
API fields
• GET /admin/ops-board → AdminOpsBoard {generatedAt, bookingsByStatus[] (status, count), overdue[] (timerType, count)}
• Drill-down: GET /admin/bookings → AdminBookingSummary
• Report section is metadata only: AdminReportMetadata (no file access without break-glass)

tF.text: F · Remaining flows: sign-up, reports & disputes, finance, lab setup, admin

nF1.text:
API fields
• POST /auth/otp/request → POST /auth/otp/verify
• POST /customer/organisations (CustomerOrganisationCreate: legal name, segment, GSTIN optional for INDIVIDUAL)
• POST /customer/sites (address + geocode)
• POST /customer/invitations (role)
• Finance: POST /auth/mfa/enrol → /auth/mfa/enrol/confirm

nF4.text:
API fields
• GET /lab/onboarding → checklist + live bookability reasons
• /lab/claims (+ /verify-otp or manual letterhead upload)
• /lab/kyc-documents · /lab/bank-accounts (step-up MFA)
• /lab/users + /lab/invitations (Checker ≠ Maker)
• /lab/sites/{siteId}/receiving-hours · closures · slot-templates · retention-rules · price-lists

nF5.text:
API fields
• GET /lab/inbox → LabInboxBookingSummary (bookingNo, customerDisplayName, itemName, lineCount, declaredPackageCount, total, slot, labDecisionDueAt)
• Accept: POST /bookings/{id}/accept (T-03)
• Reject: …/reject {reasonCode, notes} (T-05)
• Counter: …/counter BookingCounterCreate {proposedSlotId, perLineQuantity[], message}. There is no price field (BR-017).

nF7.text:
API fields
• GET /lab/sites/{siteId}/price-lists (draft / published / history); items: /lab/price-lists/{id}/items; publish: …/publish (immutable once published)
• Import: …/price-lists/imports → rows → commit
• Scope availability toggle: /lab/sites/{siteId}/scope-lines/{id}/availability
• Slots: /lab/sites/{siteId}/slots

nF8.text:
API fields
• /admin/change-sets (+ /items, /submit, /impact, /approve, /publish). The approver must be a different person.
• /admin/imports (+ /rows, /commit, /discard); mapping: /admin/mapping-templates
• Version history: /admin/records/{type}/{id}/versions

nF10.text:
API fields
• /admin/claims (+ /approve, /reject) · /admin/kyc-documents/{id}/verify · /admin/bank-accounts/{id}/verify
• /admin/geocode-queue · /admin/lab-sites/{id}/pin
• Config, notification templates, platform users, break-glass (AdminBreakGlassGrant), audit log search, leads (AdminLead)
